description: A pair of theories \(T_1,T_2\) is inseparable along common-language maps \(j_1,j_2\) when there is no common sentence \(A\) with \(T_1\vdash j_1(A)\) and \(T_2\vdash\neg j_2(A)\).
signature:

  (j₂ : L₀ →ᴸ L₂) (T₁ : L₁.Theory) (T₂ : L₂.Theory) : Prop
